mapper.sql: i.invoice_id as invoiceId, i.invoice_no as invoiceNo, i.invoice_code as invoiceCode, i.invoice_kind as invoiceKind, i.apply_id as applyId, i.red_apply_id as redApplyId, a.invoice_type as invoiceType, i.seller_name as sellerName, i.seller_tax_number as sellerTaxNumber, i.buyer_name as buyerName, i.buyer_tax_number as buyerTaxNumber, i.total_amount as totalAmount, i.total_tax as totalTax, i.total_price_tax as totalPriceTax, i.invoice_date as invoiceDate, i.red_status as redStatus, i.file_status as fileStatus, i.pdf_url as pdfUrl, i.ofd_url as ofdUrl, i.xml_url as xmlUrl, i.create_time as createTime
mapper.select:
select date_format(i.invoice_date,
'%Y-%m-%d' '%Y-%m' ) as period, sum(case when i.invoice_kind = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as blueCount, sum(case when i.invoice_kind = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as redCount from t_invoice i where i.del_flag = '0' and i.invoice_date is not null
group by period order by period asc

select a.invoice_type as invoiceType, count(1) as count from t_invoice i left join t_invoice_apply a on a.apply_id = i.apply_id where i.del_flag = '0' and i.invoice_kind = '1'
group by a.invoice_type order by a.invoice_type asc
select sum(i.total_price_tax) from t_invoice i where i.del_flag = '0' and i.total_price_tax is not null
select from t_invoice i left join t_invoice_apply a on a.apply_id = i.apply_id where i.invoice_id = #{invoiceId}
select from t_invoice i left join t_invoice_apply a on a.apply_id = i.apply_id where i.del_flag = '0' and i.apply_id = #{applyId} order by i.invoice_id asc
select from t_invoice i left join t_invoice_apply a on a.apply_id = i.apply_id where i.del_flag = '0' and i.red_apply_id = #{redApplyId} order by i.invoice_id asc
